notes.title: "Gothic 1 Remake" Gameplay Footage is in 2 Days on THQ Nordic Showcase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/8bf471c73c7c2f80606b4fa1c6f54d8acdc25b15.png
Two more sleeps until THQ Nordic's Digital Showcase! What time? You guessed it: Friday, August 2 at 12:00 PM PDT / 3:00 PM EDT / 8:00 PM BST / 9:00 PM CEST. 

For those who haven't heard it yet (didn't you read our prior press releases? Rude!): THQ Nordic’s Digital Showcase is set to bring you an array of spectacular game updates, teasers and new announcements. Included in the lineup are the highly anticipated Titan Quest II, Way of the Hunter, Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, and more! But most importantly:

Gothic 1 Remake

And keep in mind, our friends from HandyGames will kick off the event with an exciting pre-show, so be sure to tune in on time!
The pre-show starts at 11:45 AM PDT / 08:45 PM CEST – don’t miss it!

Official THQ Nordic channels to watch the Showcase:
•    YouTube: https://thqn.net/thqn2024-yt

•    Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/thqnordic

•    Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/THQNordic


Invitation to co-stream the THQ Nordic Showcase

We are more than happy to invite content creators and media outlets all over the world to co-stream the showcase on August 2nd on their own channels & react to what we are showing. Official stream time (including a neat countdown) will be announced soon. For any further questions, please reach out to the THQ Nordic PR contacts listed below.

More information and updates can be found on the official website: https://showcase.thqnordic.com/

notes.title: Gothic Remake is a headliner of the upcoming THQ Nordic Showcase 2024!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/c492ee0bef05372d28aba10c4bb2ac81e9a8c984.png
THQ Nordic's Showcase is back! Our Digital Showcase 2024 will be full of world premiere announcements, updates for previously-announced games and might even hold some surprises! Mark your calendar as the Digital Showcase 2024 goes live on Friday, August 2, 2024, at 12:00 PM PDT / 3 PM EDT / 8 PM BST / 9 PM CEST / 10 PM MSK. Our friends from HandyGames will kick things off with a pre-show once again, so tune in early and don't miss out on the fun!

We don't want to spoil too much, though, THQ Nordic will serve news for Gothic 1 Remake, Titan Quest II, and much more, but we'll keep the grim secrets to ourselves for now. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Sleeper, Sleeper On the Wall, Who Has the Fairest Collector's Edition Of All?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/971a5f89a5f071ebc74778f68967a927c659e458.png
Barcelona, Spain / Vienna, Austria, April 25th, 2024: It's time to put the sleeper to rest, once and for all - on your wall. Introducing the Gothic Collector's Edition, a carefully selected ensemble that pays homage to the legacy of this beloved title: Crafted by the hands of the King's magicians themselves, this extraordinary package is a must-have for devoted fans and those who are about to become fans. At the heart of the Gothic Collector's Edition lies the Sleeper Wall Mask to show everyone thrown into your gaming colony, what demons you are facing.

Alongside this centerpiece, the Collector's Edition includes a leather wristband, a leather notebook, the game's original soundtrack as well as the game itself on your favourite platform. This limited edition is now available for pre-order at a suggested retail price of € 199.99 / $ 199.99 / £ 169.99.

Check out the overview trailer here: [previewyoutube=SkOlUyagYq8;full][/previewyoutube]
Download the assets: https://thqn.net/g1r-media
